html:
Begin the journey at Cua Can River, where guests enjoy a peaceful kayaking experience through mangroves and natural surroundings while observing local river life.

Continue to a local bee farm to learn about honeybee cultivation and enjoy fresh honey tasting. Travel through Phu Quoc National Park before arriving at Rach Vem Fishing Village.

Enjoy lunch at the fishing village, followed by swimming and relaxing at Starfish Beach, famous for its shallow clear water and natural starfish habitat. Visit Ganh Dau Beach for a scenic viewpoint toward Cambodia. End the tour at Grand World Entertainment Theme Center or return directly to your hotel, depending on your preference.

ITINERARY

08:15 – 08:30

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Bee Farm

Learn about local honey production and enjoy honey tasting.

Cua Can River

Kayaking activity while observing local river life and natural surroundings.

Forest Walking

Short walk through the natural forest area.

Rach Vem Fishing Village

  • Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant

  • Transfer by motorboat to Ham Rong Cape (available only during the dry season from November to April)

  • Swimming and relaxing at Starfish Beach

Ganh Dau Beach

Enjoy a scenic viewpoint overlooking Cambodia from Vietnam.

16:00

Return to your hotel.

Guests who wish to be dropped off at Grand World Entertainment Theme Center may inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense and can be arranged by Vinpearl-operated shuttle bus.

TOUR PRICE

Without Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 26 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 14 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

With Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 40 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 18 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by air-conditioned car

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Kayaking activity at Cua Can River

  • Set menu lunch (if booked in advance)

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Entrance tickets at Grand World Phu Quoc, including Venice Water Taxi, Quintessence of Vietnam Show, and Teddy Bear Museum

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Guests who wish to stop at Grand World Entertainment Theme Center on the return journey should inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets are at guests’ own expense, and return transportation will be by Vinpearl-operated shuttle bus.

  • Guests are advised to bring towels, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

  • In case of unfavorable weather conditions, Rach Vem Beach may be replaced with Ganh Dau Beach to ensure safety.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for sea tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to operate, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to proceed and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towels

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility, wheelchair users, or those with medical conditions such as asthma, heart issues, seizures, panic attacks, lung or ear conditions, severe allergies, or epilepsy.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during or after the tour.
